notes.title: Progression Bug fix
notes.notes: Many players reported a bug introduced in the latest update, that prevents progress at the end of a level. My deepest apologies for this bug, but it should be fixed now. We will try to do better moving forward. Thanks to everyone that reported it to me.

notes.title: Skill Unlock Notification and Player Guide
notes.notes:
-Player Guide now found under Pause Menu. 
-Skill Unlock Notification popup appears after collecting 4th gem.

notes.title: Audio Controls and Cloud Saves
notes.notes:
Audio Controls can now be accessed through the player pause screen menu. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4MZvXLx.png[/img]

Cloud Saves were enabled a few weeks ago as well. 

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes:
This update introduces Achievements to Carpathian Night Starring Bela Lugosi! There are 22 achievements total. Unfortunately, they do not retroactively unlock if you have done some of these things before. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/c5BmiyK.png[/img]

-Bug fix: Irina's crouching attack animation would occasionally be cancelled by her crouch walk animation. 
-Loading Screen Scholomance symbol brightness increased.

notes.title: Bug fix and keyboard controls
notes.notes:
Bug fix: Player can no longer walk off screen to the left of Castle Entrance. 

Keyboard controls:

WASD - Movement
Dash - F key
Attack - L key
Pause - Escape
Submit - Return
Cancel - Backspace
